OPEN HOUSE WEDNESDAY OCTOBER 14th 5:00 - 6:30PM....NEED SPACE? You’ll Find It Here!
Welcome to 9605 Greenwald Ave, Niagara Falls, NY! This move-in-ready, all-brick ranch features comfortable first-floor living plus an impressive finished basement with endless possibilities.

The main level features 1,108 sq. ft. with 3 bedrooms and 1 full bathroom, along with a spacious living room highlighted by a cozy gas fireplace and beautiful hardwood floors. The generous kitchen and dining area provide plenty of room for everyday living and entertaining. Updated flooring, modern lighting, and a freshly painted interior create a clean, welcoming atmosphere that’s ready for you to move right in.

Looking for even more space? The finished basement adds 1,000 sq. ft. of additional living area, including two rooms that can be customized to fit your lifestyle. Create a guest suite, home theater, office, game room, family room, craft space, exercise room—or anything else you can imagine. The possibilities are truly endless! The basement also includes a full bathroom with a shower stall and a convenient laundry room.

Step outside to enjoy your private, fully fenced backyard, complete with a covered patio—perfect for entertaining, relaxing, or simply enjoying your own outdoor retreat.

Additional features include a 1-car garage with durable epoxy flooring.

With versatile living space, thoughtful updates, and room to grow, 9605 Greenwald Ave is ready to welcome you home!
